verses.28:34: وَأَخِي هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانࣰ ا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡءࣰ ا يُصَدِّقُنِيٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

meaning: The root ردأ (rdA) refers to a very heavy stone, specifically one that a strong man would struggle to lift with both hands. It implies something weighty and difficult to move.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
